definition: Seriously wrongful acts that show a lack of moral goodness.
author: Oscar Wilde
quote: Not “Forgive us our sins” but “Smite us for our iniquities” should be the prayer of man to a most just God.
example_sentence: The documentary laid bare the iniquities of the old factory system.
